label: R cinder_verge_the_struck_sentinel Medium cand|ship
brief: Fixed production-camera views of one Stormwood location (cinder verge the struck sentinel) through a storm's calm, building, break and fading phases, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the key art's Stormwood: a storm-lit purple forest realm with readable landmarks, convincing ground and light and weather that belong to the world.
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground

Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)

F41 gap 3: rigid glass slabs or white strips and smooth cyan cones that do not sit in the terrain
